definitions.gloss: unopened, sealed, still in original packaging
definitions.explanation: Describes a product or container that has not been opened from its original sealed state.

examples.japanese: {未開封|みかいふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: Only unopened items can be returned.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未開封|みかいふう}なら⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This milk will keep for a week if left unopened.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{未開封|みかいふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{忘|わす}れられていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: A package that had been forgotten while still unopened came out of the closet.

notes:
{未開封|みかいふう} means "unopened" or "still sealed." It combines ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + ⟦{開封|かいふう}→開封：16747_kaifuu⟧ (opening a seal).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未開封|みかいふう}: unopened, still sealed
- ⟦{開封|かいふう}→開封：16747_kaifuu⟧⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already opened

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {未開封|みかいふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in the case of being unopened
- {未開封|みかいふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: while still unopened
- {未開封|みかいふう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: unopened item
- {未開封|みかいふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: only if unopened

OTHER {未|み}～ WORDS:
- ⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧: unused
- ⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧: unread
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete, unfinished
- ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧: undecided, TBD

USAGE:
Frequently seen on return policies, food labeling, and online marketplace listings.
